name: School Captain: Kaichou Kouho wa Gorippuku
original_name: SchoolCaptain 会長候補はご立腹
source:
The protagonist, Kira Keisuke, is on the verge of failing the year.
He’s managed to score failing grades in every subject—a grand slam of academic failure.
To avoid repeating the year, his teachers propose a deal: convince his childhood friend, Igarashi Rin, to run for student council president and compete in the National Student Council Competition.

Everyone—from the school staff to the students—believes Rin has what it takes to dominate the intense competition.
But her response is a resounding, "Absolutely not!!"
With no other options, the task falls squarely on Keisuke’s shoulders.

Reluctantly, Keisuke sets out to persuade her, only to be met with a swift kick to the face from her elegant foot.
Still, he can’t back down now. Desperate, he tries every trick in the book to win her over.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ056427.html/]dlsite[/url]]
